clarification.mapping: Evaluation day D uses only the sealed point-in-time universe snapshot from D-1.
clarification.calendar_shift: The first evaluation day is one UTC day after the first formation snapshot; the final evaluation day is one UTC day after the final formation snapshot.
clarification.manifest_binding: Every evaluation day must bind the exact prior-day snapshot SHA-256, manifest SHA-256, protocol fingerprint, and eligible-symbol set before any return archive is acquired.
clarification.write_once: The activation lock is immutable after creation; a different recomputation is an integrity failure.

unchanged: 180 consecutive point-in-time universe snapshots remain the activation threshold
the final 60 evaluation days remain inaccessible to development
no return archive may be acquired before readiness and preregistration
this amendment does not authorize Experiment 0015 or live trading
reason: A date-only 120/60 calendar could be constructed without proving that each trading day used its exact prior-day sealed universe. This amendment closes that survivorship and membership-lag gap without changing a performance parameter.
